zh-CN.name: 研究证据 Agent
zh-CN.shortDesc: 围绕研究问题收集资料、整理证据等级，并生成可回到原文的结论摘要
zh-CN.fullDesc:
它会先把研究问题拆清楚，再从允许使用的资料源中收集文献和数据，记录作者、出处、时间和引用位置。不同证据可以按团队规则分级，最后形成带引用的摘要与待确认问题。

它不会把搜索结果冒充研究结论。涉及医学、法律或投资判断时，仍需相应专业人员复核。

en-US.name: Research Evidence Agent
en-US.shortDesc: Collects material around a research question, organizes evidence strength, and produces summaries linked to the source text.
en-US.fullDesc:
It starts by clarifying the research question, then gathers literature and data from approved sources while recording authors, provenance, dates, and citation locations. Evidence can be graded using team-defined rules before producing a cited summary and a list of unresolved questions.

Search results are not presented as research conclusions. Medical, legal, and investment decisions still require qualified review.
